title: skills(automation): the connector input recipe still says os validate does not judge connectorConfig.input, which PR #28150 makes false
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibwb6hBqszPTYJobitm

Filing gate: ② the `Skills-docs:` follow-up owed by PR #28150 (#27968), escalated as should-fix ④.1 by its contract review, record 6525595405. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 1. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and routes the card to the skills lane (`skills/**` is a governed surface).

Reach: every AI author that the `objectstack-automation` skill teaches to wire a `connector_action`. Once #28150 merges, the skill tells them a `{…}` or `{{ }}` token in `connectorConfig.input` is literal text that `os validate` does not judge. In fact both `registerFlow` and `os validate` now refuse it at `connectorConfig.input.<key>`. An author who follows the recipe is refused by a door the recipe says is silent.

## Files (measured on the #28150 head `6a06a420`)

- `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md:88`: "`os validate` does not judge it yet, so a malformed envelope fails at run time".
- `skills/objectstack-automation/references/integration-recipes.md:18-21`: "`{…}`, `{{ }}` are literal text … does not judge it yet".
- `skills/objectstack-automation/evals/integrations-declared.json:7` already calls the input a value slot and is not false. Re-read it when the text changes.

## What changes

- Rewrite both passages so they teach the rule on `main` after #28150. `connectorConfig.input` values are value slots, judged at publish by `registerFlow` and `os validate`. A template token is refused at `connectorConfig.input.<key>`, and a value that needs the record is written as a CEL envelope.
- Run the skill's evals afterwards.

Links: #27968, PR #28150 (record 6525595405).

Blocked-by: #28150
